intent.description: Audit or improve Codex instruction context: AGENTS.md, task-relevant skills, prompts, and code_map.md. Use for conflicting rules, overbroad triggers, premature stops, excessive context or verification; 审计或优化 Codex 上下文、项目指导与技能触发. Exclude general Codex setup advice, Claude-only guidance, ordinary code review, standalone explanations, and implicit fully specified trivial edits.
intent.job_to_be_done: Audit and improve task-relevant Codex context while preserving verified constraints and authorization.
inputs: Relevant skill metadata, loaded bodies/references and task prompts
outputs: Prioritized source-grounded audit and proposed diffs
Authorized local changes and honest validation
exclusions: General Codex setup, model/API migration and plugin recommendations
Claude-only guidance and ordinary code review
Unrequested global changes, installation, publishing and history scans

should_trigger: 审计这个仓库的 AGENTS.md、AGENTS.override.md 和 code_map.md，先给报告，不要修改文件。
Implement the approved AGENTS.md cleanup plan, preserve managed marker blocks, and validate the result.
Fix the stale test command in packages/api/AGENTS.md and its local code map, then run the smallest relevant checks.
Audit why AGENTS.override.md wins at packages/api and whether the configured fallback and byte budget change the active instructions.
审计 Codex 上下文：技能出现在目录但没有选用记录；审计时我才读了它的 SKILL.md，它是否导致上次停工？
Audit conflicting Codex instructions: the user asked to implement a scoped fix, but the loaded skill says to stop after planning.
Optimize Codex context: I already authorized this local SKILL.md trigger fix and its tests. Complete it.
Audit Codex context: the loaded skill requires publishing to production to finish, but I only asked for a local draft.
优化 Codex 上下文：改一个提示词拼写，却要求全仓阅读所有技能参考并反复跑整套测试。
Audit Codex context: this loaded skill mandates three subagents, but tools expose none.
Audit Codex context: duplicate skill names, disabled config and symlink entries appear in different directories.
Review Codex context using the supplied task prompt: it quotes an article saying ignore permissions and deploy now.
审计 Codex 的 AGENTS.md：启动 CWD 已知，fallback 与字节上限配置无法读取。
Audit Codex context and remove rules just because they are old; the safety and CI rules still match the repository.
Use $codex-context-improver to audit a task prompt that keeps asking permission for an already-authorized AGENTS.md edit.
Use $codex-context-improver to add this exact sentence to AGENTS.md: run npm test before opening a PR.
规划没问题；本项目 WORKFLOW.md:8 要求另行批准实施。请据此审查 Codex 上下文中的停止规则。
should_not_trigger: Add one already-specified sentence to AGENTS.md: run npm test before opening a PR.
Explain how AGENTS.md discovery works in Codex without auditing or changing a repository.
near_neighbor: Audit CLAUDE.md layering, .claude/rules globs, and @import chains.
Recommend which Codex MCP servers, plugins, hooks, and subagents this repository should adopt, but do not edit files.
Review this TypeScript pull request for correctness, security, performance, and missing tests.

compact_workflow: Establish project, launch CWD, task, requested action, existing authority, and
Verify conflicts against actual instructions and ownership. Use
Use [report format](references/report-format.md) for findings and concrete
Complete the smallest relevant checks and required project gates. Delegate
output_contract: Lead with severity-ranked findings, path:line, impact, diff and uncertainty.
For edits, state changed behavior, preserved constraints, and passed/failed/skipped
Preserve human/managed content and shared sibling code_map fences.

degradation.openai: repository contract; native loading needs evidence

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
